question: ‘Anaconda’ one of the world’s largest snakes is found in ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tropical evergreen forest.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

Tropical evergreen forests:

__
 
• Tropical evergreen forests have trees that always have leaves and have a shade look.
 
• They always receive heavy rainfall i.e greater than 200 cm.
 
• The temperature that is maintained is between 20-27o C.
 
• The trees reach great heights up to 60 metres or even above.
 
• These are generally found in the Western Ghats, Andaman, and Nicobar, North East Area.
 
• Examples of tropical evergreen are Rubber, Beetle Nut, Jamun, Mango, Roseberry, and Bamboo.
 
• These forests have a multilayered structure with trees, shrubs and creepers.
 
• There is no definite time for trees to shed their leaves.
 
• As such, these forests appear green all year round.
 
• Anacondas can be seen in the Amazon River.
 
 
• Anacondas are a group of large snakes found in the tropical evergreen forest of South America.
 
• Only four species of Anacondas are currently recognized.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

​Semi-evergreen forests:

__
 
• Semi-evergreen forests are found in the Western Ghats, Andaman and Nicobar Islands, and the Eastern Himalayas.
 
• Such forests have a mixture of wet evergreen trees and moist deciduous trees.
 
• The forest is dense and is filled with a large variety of trees of both types.
